architecture.planner: plan_shots: authored JSON, optional local LLM, structural fallback
architecture.execution: single coordinator thread, bounded queue, one FFmpeg consumer
architecture.recovery: atomic state.json, OS workspace lock, saved provider markers and clip checksums
architecture.provisioning: automatic_workflow -> provision_model; existing requirements.txt and setup lock
architecture.storage: local verified copy/hard link, Google OAuth2, Dropbox verified upload
architecture.review: history previews and protected deletion; no original cinematic plan editor

verified_runtime.gpu: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Max-Q Workstation Edition

risks: An active production must retain its workflow and checkpoint schema.
Registered H3 nodes do not imply installed compatible weights.
Free disk cannot safely accommodate a new large H3 installation.
Official provider POST does not document a replay-safe idempotency key; ambiguous submissions need task recovery.
No installed vision evaluator or speech recognizer has been verified; visual and dialogue quality cannot be scored objectively.
Existing native latent chaining requires a model-compatible exported graph; it is not universal.
incremental_changes: Add cinematic_engine.py behind new-job orchestration settings; retain old APIs/checkpoints.
Extend the existing dependency manifest/setup lock rather than replace model provisioning.
Add capability-based planning and official H3 V2 adapter with reference budgets and safe submission journaling.
Make duration/audio/assembly use checkpointed shot durations while keeping old five-second defaults.
Add plan inspection, editable drafts, versioned uploaded keyframes, review, pause and targeted regeneration.
Validate a staged replacement and real FFmpeg processing before service rollout.
